references.text: The peace offering of cattle is described in detail here, corresponding to the bull and ram as a peace offering in Leviticus 9:4
The rules for the peace offering include unleavened cakes mixed with oil, corresponding to the grain offering mixed with oil mentioned in the verse
A grain offering of unleavened cakes mixed with oil corresponds to the mincha offering mixed with oil in Leviticus 9:4
The glory of the Lord was revealed to Israel on Mount Sinai, similar to the promise that the Lord would show Himself to the people on this day
God promises to meet the Israelites at the tabernacle and reveal His glory, which is fulfilled in Leviticus 9
Moses repeats the promise that the glory of the Lord will be revealed to the people, confirming the message in verse 4
The fulfillment of the promise that the Lord would show Himself, when the glory of the Lord was revealed and fire came from the Lord
The glory of the Lord was revealed to the whole congregation, showing God's visible presence among His people
